subject.title: fix(agents): drop stale internal orphan prompts

question: Should the canonical fix for https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/76888 use this PR's selected-internal-leaf drop semantics, or the open preserve-as-context/session-replay strategy in https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/90759?
rationale: Both branches target the same session-state bug with different model-visible prompt semantics, and this branch still lacks real embedded-runner proof.

options.title: Keep This Branch Paused For Proof
options.body: Require redacted embedded-agent runtime output for this PR's internal-drop and `sessions_send` preservation paths before deciding it should be canonical.

options.title: Select The Proven Broader PR
options.body: Use https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/90759 as the canonical landing path if maintainers prefer preserving the older user text as context-only with metadata replay.

options.title: Accept Drop Semantics
options.body: Proceed with this PR only if maintainers can provide or accept equivalent runtime proof and explicitly own the six-source predicate scope.

recommendation.title: Keep This Branch Paused For Proof
recommendation.body: Require redacted embedded-agent runtime output for this PR's internal-drop and `sessions_send` preservation paths before deciding it should be canonical.

likelyOwner.reason: They introduced the queued-user prompt preservation behavior and are the clearest history route for deciding whether dropping selected internal orphan leaves is acceptable.
